title: Quản lý chương trình và dự án

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced knowledge of programs and projects, including preparation and implementation phases, and analyze their effectiveness and bidding processes.
Master skills in group management, teamwork, communication, and conflict resolution.
Proficient in planning, organizing, leading, and controlling in program and project management.
Proficient in analyzing, establishing, and evaluating programs and projects, and using supporting methods and tools.
Capable of independent work and professional responsibility, actively planning, coordinating, evaluating, and improving professional tasks.
Capable of expressing and defending personal viewpoints, identifying and fulfilling social responsibilities, and developing self-learning and improvement skills.
